name: Rear Rotors
description: ZL1 / ZL1 1LE rear: 365 x 28 mm vented one-piece rotor whose hat doubles as the parking-brake drum (drum-in-hat). Race: two-piece floating disc with a drum-in-hat compatible bell (Essex/AP 365x30) or a park-brake delete.

components.name: Rear brake rotor (with drum-in-hat)
components.description: Vented one-piece rotor; the inside of the hat is the friction drum for the parking-brake shoes. Rotor will not come off if the park brake is applied or shoes are worn into a lip – back the shoes off (service mode/cable slack) first.

factory.name: GM/Brembo 365 x 28 mm one-piece rear rotor (ZL1/ZL1 1LE)
factory.notes: One-piece per TSB. Base cars 12.4 in (315 mm).

raceOptions.name: AP Racing 365 x 30 mm 72-vane disc (Essex rear kit)

installNotes: Clean hub face; install shoes first; check runout < 0.05 mm.
inspection: Thickness and cracks as front; check drum surface for scoring.
